name: Hoping This Finds You Well
source:
An experiment in letter writing, meant to evoke the distinctly sweet homoerotisicm of Victorian and Edwardian literature. Follow the correspondence of two professors, in the months before one of them makes a decision he'll never be able to take back.

[From [url=https://alexisroyce.itch.io/hoping-this-finds-you-well]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一次书信体写作的尝试，旨在唤起维多利亚与爱德华时代文学中那种独特而温存的同性恋情愫。跟随两位教授在其中一人做出永远无法挽回的决定前数月间的书信往来。

[引自[url=https://alexisroyce.itch.io/hoping-this-finds-you-well]itch.io[/url]]
